title: Pay the up-front payments tuition protection levy
what: A levy is imposed each year on a body that is a leviable provider under the Act at any time during the year.

laws.title: Higher Education (Up-front Payments Tuition Protection Levy) Act 2020

sources.title: Higher Education (Up-front Payments Tuition Protection Levy) Act 2020
sources.quote: 6 Imposition of up-front payments tuition protection levy Levy is imposed by this section on a body, for a year starting on or after the commencement of this section, if the body is a leviable provider at any time during the year.
